basics.name: Pedro Azevedo
basics.label: Engineering Manager
basics.summary: Engineering Manager with a hands-on approach to software development. Strong consulting background and proven track record of delivering multiple applications for diverse sectors. My goal is transforming business requirements into software and leading software development teams.

highlights: Lead multiple times multi disciplinary teams to deliver projects from beginning to end, with quality deliveries and strong team dynamics
Lead different projects of varied scales and focuses (web, mobile, infrastructure)
Founded development chapter in the company, creating space for a strong tech culture, discussing topics as security, platform and testing
Served as a strong interface between business and tech, providing the team and the client the required context for successful projects
Improved the hiring processes and contributed to establishing growth plan for the tech team
Designed and implemented scalable cloud-native solutions within a distributed systems environment.
Developed high-throughput distributed systems using C# and Azure.
Lead technical workshops with clients and acted as team lead on client teams
Strategic technical leadership for a large-scale digital transformation.
Assisted on a project expansion from a single team to over 10 cross-functional squads.
Guided architectural discussions across Backend, Frontend, and Infrastructure teams. Establishing strong DDD boundaries to facilitate complex domain discussions
Established a 'Subject Matter Expert' (SME) framework to decentralize knowledge and empower developers.
Worked on several restaurant components, such as POS and Kitchen components
Worked close to markets on on premise deployments, owning migration processes for different markets
Development and support of Monolith Application (Cpp, Java, Qt) and development of new features (C#)
